messages:
Alex: Heads up — quiet window in ~90m. Posting a short pre-freeze checklist here so everyone knows whos owning what.

Maria: Copy. Ill publish release notes + migration blurb in ~15m and pin the doc link back here.

Sam: Quick question: are we pinning main -> v3.4.2 for the freeze? Need to lock before canary kicks.

Alex: Yes, pin v3.4.2 for the 24h freeze. Exceptions only via oncall + eng-lead approval.

Deploy Bot: deploy scheduled by @Alex  canary rollout (12% traffic) at 1729005400 UTC. Status: scheduled.

SRE-Oncall: Smoke test plan ready. Ill run `/smoke run --suite=canary --verbose` at -20 and post pass/fail.

Jordan: Rollback triggers we agreed: error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 2s for 7m -> auto rollback. Manual rollback on any DB connection errors.

Maria: Release notes published: https://internal.redwood/releases/3.4.2  includes API diff, migration steps, and a note about embedding jobs overlapping the window.

Lina: Flag: our nightly embeddings job overlaps the quiet window and spikes infra. Recommend disabling batch workers for the 24h period.

Alex: Agreed, disable embedding batch cron for the freeze and set ingestion concurrency=1. Please confirm when done.

Sam: `deploy-bot pin v3.4.2` executed. Pin shows locked. Added Sam + SRE-Oncall as emergency unpin approvers.

SRE-Oncall: Condensed rollback snippet for canary (shared here for quick copy):
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:v3.4.1
deploy-bot unpin v3.4.2
kubectl rollout status deploy/api -n prod --watch
```

Taylor: Ill keep an eye on traces and error budgets — will escalate if spans or traces spike unexpectedly.

Deploy Bot: canary started -> 12% traffic. Monitoring: https://monitoring.redwood/canary/3.4.2

SRE-Oncall: First smoke run at -12m -> PASS. No migration locks on DB. Will re-run at +10m.

Alex: Rollout plan: if canary stable at +15m, increase to 40% at +30m, then 70% at +60m, full at +90m. Ill post go/no-go at -5.

Maria: Ive posted a short rollout checklist in the release thread and updated the oncall roster.

Jordan: On watch — ping `@Jordan` on this thread for any immediate attention.

Alex: GO for canary -> executing now :rocket:

SRE-Oncall: Night SRE is standing by. Will post realtime alarms to paging channel if anything trips.

Sam: Emergency rollback playbook uploaded to ops docs. Confirmed pin remains until freeze end unless emergency unpin.

Maria: Noted. Ill notify product leads and add a note for small clients to delay major syncs until after freeze.

Alex: Thanks everyone. Use this thread for updates. Final status check-in at +2h.
